ALMA TAP ivoa.obscore - 73 columns
================================================================================

access_estsize
  Type: int, Unit: kbyte
  Estimated size of datasets in kilobytes

access_format
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Content format of the data

access_url
  Type: char, Unit: 
  URL to download the data

antenna_arrays
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Blank-separated list of Pad:Antenna pairs, i.e., A109:DV09 J504:DV02 J505:DV05 for antennas DV09, DV02 and DV05 sitting on pads A109, J504, and J505, respectively.

asdm_uid
  Type: char, Unit: 
  UID of the ASDM containing this Field.

authors
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Full list of first author and all co-authors

band_list
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Space delimited list of bands

bandwidth
  Type: double, Unit: Hz
  Total Bandwidth

bib_reference
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Bibliography code

calib_level
  Type: int, Unit: 
  calibration level (2 or 3). 2 if product_type = MOUS, 3 if product_type = GOUS

collections
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Indicates that there are external products

cont_sensitivity_bandwidth
  Type: double, Unit: mJy/beam
  Estimated noise in the aggregated continuum bandwidth. Note this is an indication only, it does not include the effects of flagging or dynamic range limitations.

data_rights
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Access to data.

dataproduct_type
  Type: char, Unit: 
  type of product

em_max
  Type: double, Unit: m
  stop spectral coordinate value

em_min
  Type: double, Unit: m
  start spectral coordinate value

em_res_power
  Type: double, Unit: 
  typical spectral resolution

em_resolution
  Type: double, Unit: m
  Estimated frequency resolution from all the spectral windows, using median values of channel widths.

em_xel
  Type: int, Unit: 
  Number of elements along the spectral axis

facility_name
  Type: char, Unit: 
  telescope name

first_author
  Type: char, Unit: 
  The first author as provided by <a href="http://telbib.eso.org">telbib.eso.org</a>.

frequency
  Type: double, Unit: GHz
  Observed (tuned) reference frequency on the sky.

frequency_support
  Type: char, Unit: GHz
  All frequency ranges used by the field

gal_latitude
  Type: double, Unit: deg
  Galactic latitude of the observation for RA/Dec. Estimated using PyEphem and RA/Dec.

gal_longitude
  Type: double, Unit: deg
  Galactic longitude of the observation for RA/Dec. Estimated using PyEphem and RA/Dec.

group_ous_uid
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Group OUS ID

instrument_name
  Type: char, Unit: 
  instrument name

is_mosaic
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Flag to indicate if this ASDM represents a mosaic or not.

lastModified
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Time stamp of last modification of the metadata

member_ous_uid
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Member OUS ID

o_ucd
  Type: char, Unit: 
  UCD describing the observable axis (pixel values)

obs_collection
  Type: char, Unit: 
  short name for the data collection

obs_creator_name
  Type: char, Unit: 
  case-insensitive partial match over the full PI name. Wildcards can be used

obs_id
  Type: char, Unit: 
  internal dataset identifier

obs_publisher_did
  Type: char, Unit: 
  publisher dataset identifier

obs_release_date
  Type: char, Unit: 
  timestamp of date the data becomes publicly available

obs_title
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Case-insensitive search over the project title

pi_name
  Type: char, Unit: 
  

pi_userid
  Type: char, Unit: 
  

pol_states
  Type: char, Unit: 
  polarization states present in the data

pol_xel
  Type: int, Unit: 
  Number of polarization samples

proposal_abstract
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Text search on the proposal abstract. Only abstracts will be returned which contain the given text. The search is case-insensitive.

proposal_authors
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Full name of CoIs .

proposal_id
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Identifier of proposal to which NO observation belongs.

pub_abstract
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Case insensitive text search through the abstract of the publication.

pub_title
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Case insensitive search through the title of the publication.

publication_year
  Type: int, Unit: 
  The year the publication did appear in the printed version of the refereed journal.

pwv
  Type: float, Unit: mm
  Estimated precipitable water vapour from the XML_CALWVR_ENTITIES table.

qa2_passed
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Quality Assessment 2 status: does the Member / Group OUS fulfil the PI's requirements?

s_dec
  Type: double, Unit: deg
  DEC of central coordinates

s_fov
  Type: double, Unit: deg
  size of the region covered (~diameter of minimum bounding circle)

s_ra
  Type: double, Unit: deg
  RA of central coordinates

s_region
  Type: char, Unit: 
  region bounded by observation

s_resolution
  Type: double, Unit: arcsec
  typical spatial resolution

s_xel1
  Type: int, Unit: 
  Number of elements along the first spatial axis

s_xel2
  Type: int, Unit: 
  Number of elements along the second spatial axis

scan_intent
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Scan intent list for the observed field.

schedblock_name
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Name of the Scheduling Block used as a template for executing the ASDM containing this Field.

science_keyword
  Type: char, Unit: 
  

science_observation
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Flag to indicate whether this is a science observation.

scientific_category
  Type: char, Unit: 
  

sensitivity_10kms
  Type: double, Unit: mJy/beam
  Estimated noise in an nominal 10km/s bandwidth. Note this is an indication only, it does not include the effects of flagging or Hanning smoothing, and a 10km/s bandwidth may not be achievable with the data as taken.

spatial_resolution
  Type: double, Unit: arcsec
  Average of the maximum and minimum spatial resolution values of all spectral windows

spatial_scale_max
  Type: double, Unit: arcsec
  Due to the fact that radio antennas can not be placed infinitely close, measurements do have a smallest separation which translates into a maximal angular distance beyond which features can not be resolved reliably any more. Adding observations with the ALMA Total Power array can add those missing largest scales.

spectral_resolution
  Type: double, Unit: kHz
  

t_exptime
  Type: double, Unit: s
  exposure time of observation

t_max
  Type: double, Unit: d
  end time of observation (MJD)

t_min
  Type: double, Unit: d
  start time of observation (MJD)

t_resolution
  Type: double, Unit: s
  typical temporal resolution

t_xel
  Type: int, Unit: 
  Number of elements along the time axis

target_name
  Type: char, Unit: 
  name of intended target

type
  Type: char, Unit: 
  Type flags.

velocity_resolution
  Type: double, Unit: m/s
  Estimated velocity resolution from all the spectral windows, from frequency resolution.
